digest.component_or_area: network-capable git call sites (gerrit_client and opcert workspace)
propositions: Network-capable git calls in gerrit_client.clone_change_ref and opcert_service.workspace run without a timeout and can block indefinitely on a stuck remote or hung credential helper.
Add a module-level _GIT_TIMEOUT = 300 to both modules and forward it to every subprocess git call, matching the cold-fetch profile of bug 747f rather than the 30s _store increment.
A subprocess.TimeoutExpired in clone_change_ref escapes the existing except tuple and its cmd carries a user:token@host URL, making an unhandled timeout a credential-disclosure path.
Convert TimeoutExpired to a GerritError routed through token redaction and to a WorkspaceError in workspace._git, each naming the git operation and the bound, never propagating the raw exception.
The two _ref_lock.py sites are already structurally bounded via a required timeout keyword and were confirmed and left unedited.
git archive in snapshot.py batches its promisor prefetch into one fetch and is not an instance of the 747f unbounded-fetch bug class.
